::: {.lede}
This repository is only as accurate as the data flowing into it. If you represent a National Malaria Control Programme (NMCP), or you've spotted a guideline that needs updating, please use the form below. Your submission is written directly to the Google Sheet that this site reads from.
:::

## How submissions flow

1. You fill out the form (it takes 3–8 minutes depending on how much you choose to share).
2. The response lands as a new row in the **`Submissions`** tab of the shared Google Sheet.
3. The repository team reviews the submission, reconciles it against the existing record for that country, and (if appropriate) updates the corresponding row in the main data sheet.
4. On the next site rebuild, your update appears here. Rebuilds happen automatically on a weekly schedule, and manually whenever a significant change comes in.

::: {.callout-edit}
**Sensitivity.** Per the project design, NMCPs may flag data points as visible only to other malaria programmes, partners, and researchers — not to the public site. The form includes a sensitivity question for each major section. Anything flagged "restricted" is held in a separate tab and does not render on the public site.
:::

## Prefer to email?

If a longer conversation, an attached PDF of a new national guideline, or restricted information is involved, please email the repository team at **vivax-repository@example.org**. Use the subject line "Policy update — [Country name]".

## What we ask for

The form mirrors the structure of a country profile. The minimum useful submission is just three fields:

- Country
- The thing that has changed (a free-text box)
- Your name and role (so we can follow up)

The fuller form lets you supply any of: first-line treatment, second-line treatment, G6PD testing policy, G6PD implementation status, primaquine regimens by G6PD status, follow-up requirements, the latest guideline PDF or URL, the year of the guideline, and contact information for the programme.

## Versioning

Every change to a country's record is recorded with a date, the source (form, email, published guideline), and a brief note. The version history for any country is visible at the bottom of its [country profile](countries.qmd).

::: {.callout-edit}
**Setup note (for site administrators).** The iframe above requires two things to work: a Google Form with the fields above, and a link from the form's "Responses" tab to the same Google Sheet that the rest of the site reads from. See `methods.qmd`, the project README, and [`docs/google-form-template.md`](docs/google-form-template.md) for full setup instructions and copy-paste question wording.
:::
